ja307:1.1: Acetanaṃ brāhmaṇa assuṇantaṃ (cfr. Milinda p. jāno ajānantam imaṃ palāsaṃ āraddhaviriyo dhuvaṃ appamatto sukhaseyyaṃ pucchasi kissa hetū 'ti.
ja307:2.1: Dūre suto c' eva brahā ca rukkho dese ṭhito bhūtanivāsarūpo, tasmā namassāmi imaṃ palāsaṃ ye c' ettha bhūtā te ca dhanassa hetū 'ti.
ja307:3.1: So te karissāmi yathānubhāvaṃ kataññutaṃ brāhmaṇa pekkhamāno, kathaṃ hi āgamma sataṃ sakāse moghā te assu pariphanditāni.
ja307:4.1: Yo tindurukkhassa paro pilakkhu parivārito pubbayañño uḷāro tass' esa mūlasmiṃ nidhī nikhāto adāyādo, gaccha, taṃ uddharāhīti.
